claims.citation: New York Herald, 29 September 1866, p. 8, col. 5
claims.verbatim:
Bark Katherine Maude (Br), Innes, Antwerp, 47 days,
with mdse, to Funch, Meincke & Wendt. Had heavy west-
erly gales the entire passage. Aug 23 lat 49 48, lon 15 05,
spoke bark Danish Princess (Br), from South America,
bound for Liverpool; Sept 22, lat 43 25, lon 59 29, encountered
a very heavy gale from SW, and carried away foretopmast,
maintopsail, mainsail and jib.

Bark Catharine Maude (of Picton, N. S.), Innes, Antwerp, 47 days,
with mdse. to Funch, Meincke & Wendt. Has had heavy westerly
gales the entire passage. Aug. 22, lat. 49 48, long. 15 04, spoke Br.
bark Danish Princess, from South America bound for Liverpool;
Sept. 22, lat. 43 25, long. 69 29, encountered a very heavy gale from
SW and carried away foretopmast, maintopsail, mainsail and jib.
